verdict.rationale: MotherDuck is a cloud data warehouse with in-product AI features such as Dives and natural-language analysis. A buyer could fairly ask whether such a platform can consume external MCP servers, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only MotherDuck acting as an MCP server (remote and local) for outside agents. Nothing shows it can connect to or use third-party MCP servers' tools, and server-side evidence does not count toward this client-side story.
